headlines.text: That Sunday in 2024, it was title-change night for the AEW World Tag Team Titles as Allin & Sting vs. The Young Bucks battled it out in a Tornado Tag match, appearing on Revolution, rated 9.45 ? as good as professional wrestling gets ? ending the champion's reign at 5 defenses. In what became Sting's final match, the 64-year-old legend and Darby Allin fought off the Young Bucks with help from a ringside Ric Flair and Ricky Steamboat, sending Sting into retirement undefeated as a tag champion.
Turning the clock back to 2021: Jade Cargill arrived in AEW against Shaq vs. Cody Rhodes vs. Red Velvet, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.20.
Flash back to 2023, when Boudreaux & Strickland didn't ease in ? their first AEW match was the main event as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 4.87.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2024, when Eddie Kingston vs. Bryan Danielson went to battle over the ROH World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Revolution, rated 8.47 ? a fantastic contest. It was the 20th time the ROH World Heavyweight Title had been on the line, a nice marker in that championship's story. In an emotional grudge match tied to Danielson's disrespect of his idol Jun Akiyama, Kingston retained the Continental Crown Championship ? and earned a handshake of respect from Danielson afterward.

2024 brought us this moment: the AEW International Title found a new home as Roderick Strong vs. Orange Cassidy battled it out, appearing on Revolution, rated 7.28 ? a good, competitive contest ? ending the champion's reign at 12 defenses. It was the first title opportunity of Roderick Strong's career. Strong pinned Cassidy clean with the End of Heartache to become the new AEW International Champion, with a returning Kyle O'Reilly appearing during the celebration.

Looking back to 2024, when Samoa Joe vs. Adam Page vs. Swerve Strickland went to battle over the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Revolution, rated 8.08 ? a real highlight of the night. Joe choked out Page in a three-way world title match, narrowly retaining after Page and Strickland had briefly teamed up to try to take him out.
